title: Tyler Robinson, man accused of shooting Charlie Kirk, to face trial in 2028
summary: A ​Utah judge on Monday set a June 2028 trial date for Tyler Robinson, the man accused of murdering prominent right-wing activist Charlie Kirk last year.

image.caption: A ​Utah judge on Monday set a June 2028 trial date for Tyler Robinson, the man accused of murdering prominent right-wing activist Charlie Kirk last year. (Erin Hooley/The Deseret News/The Associated Press)
